title: +FRAMING YOUR CAREER PLAN
description: Develop career-based skills and gain knowledge on how to communicate one's value in the workplace. Explore effective job search strategies and design a personalized professional growth plan.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: BA 160, 160H, 381 or 280.
A minimum grade of C- is required in BA 160, BA 160H, BA 381 and BA 280.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in:

  • Supply Chain & Logistics Mgmt (075)
  • Business Administration (181)
  • Finance (182)
  • Business Information Systems (183)
  • Management (196)
  • Accountancy (641)
  • Marketing (799)
  • Business Analytics (899)
  • Organizational Leadership (A018)
  • Innovation & Entrepreneurship (A039)
  • Sports Business (A050)
attribute_description: Core Education - Beyond OSU II, Career Engagement (CSC2)
meeting_html: W 1pm-1:50pm in AUST 183 - Austin Hall 183 (9/23 to 12/4)
